name: v12.87
body:
## In short

A **REST API** "get one" that finds nothing answers **404**
instead of 200 with an empty body.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG-big.md#v1287-2026-11-03-wekan--release)

name: v12.86
body:
## In short

The daily **notification cleanup** and the **file integrity
audit**
run once for the whole installation, not once per server.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG-big.md#v1286-2026-11-02-wekan--release)

name: v12.85
body:
## In short

The findings of the **accessibility audit** are fixed in the
default theme: header and label **colour contrast**, names that contain the
visible text, named form fields, card section headings that are real buttons,
and landmarks and headings on every page. axe-core now finds no violation on
22 pages. A cleared database connection pool is reported as a lost connection.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG-big.md#v1285-2026-11-02-wekan--release)

name: v12.84
body:
## In short

GitHub code scanning's **code-quality** findings are fixed: a
promise formatted as text, undeclared globals, an upload that hung on an
unreadable file, and the lint around them. `npm run lint:promises`
now finds promises that are not awaited or handled.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG-big.md#v1284-2026-11-02-wekan--release)

name: v12.83
body:
## In short

An **LDAP** login with a reused login name no longer opens the
previous owner's account, and existing accounts record their directory
identifier.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG-big.md#v1283-2026-11-02-wekan--release)

name: v12.82
body:
## In short

A card moved to another board, restored from the archive or given
a number no longer takes a **card number** another card on that board has.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG-big.md#v1282-2026-11-02-wekan--release)

name: v12.81
body:
## In short

The **database health** probe reports a finding once, not once
per server.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG-big.md#v1281-2026-11-02-wekan--release)

name: v12.80
body:
## In short

**minimatch** is updated to 11.0.4 for GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249, a
glob pattern that used up CPU and memory.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG-big.md#v1280-2026-11-02-wekan--release)

name: v12.79
body:
## In short

A cluster of servers runs the **schema re-check** and the
**due-date reminders** once, and a slow-query warning says which query it is.
The site **announcement** shows on Home and All
Boards too. The **date picker** popup shows the year and has year, month and
day drop-downs under the calendar. The **macOS sandbox** for VSCodium no longer
asks for a keychain, starts from the checkout, and can carry a **Claude Code**
token so its login sticks.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG-big.md#v1279-2026-11-02-wekan--release)

name: v12.78
body:
## In short

**CrossBoardExportBleed** and **UnassignedAttachBleed** are
fixed: a checklist scope stays on its board, every export obeys Disable all
export and Anonymize export users, and an assigned-only member changes
attachments only on their own cards. **SAML** logins use **node-saml 5.2.0**,
and **continuous backup** no longer misses a change made right after it starts.
**Keyboard shortcuts** keep working after a popup closes, and the Rules page has
a way back to the board.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG-big.md#v1278-2026-11-02-wekan--release)

name: v12.77
body:
## In short

Two **node test guards** follow the movable popups and the date
picker of v12.76.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG-big.md#v1277-2026-10-31-wekan--release)

name: v12.76
body:
## In short

Security features: a **password policy** with an optional
breached-password check, **Admin Panel / Problems / Password length**,
**compulsory two-factor authentication**, sign-out of **idle sessions** and of
every session after a password change, an **audit log** of what administrators
did, **HSTS**, a cross-site request guard, and **S3 encryption at rest**.
**Sign-up** works again; the date picker has **Today**, the whole card title
edits and **every popup can be moved**; and an old **Sandstorm** grain migrated
from MongoDB 3 shows its boards again.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG-big.md#v1276-2026-10-31-wekan--release)

name: v12.75
body:
## In short

Changing a password signs the account out in every other browser,
and now a test proves it in two real browsers.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG-big.md#v1275-2026-10-30-wekan--release)

name: v12.74
body:
## In short

**Caddy** and **FerretDB**, the Go servers WeKan ships, no longer
open MPTCP listeners, which Linux kernel bug **CVE-2026-98432** is reachable
through. The real fix is a patched host kernel.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG-big.md#v1274-2026-10-30-wekan--release)

name: v12.73
body:
## In short

**CHANGELOG.md** is now short: the In short of the upcoming
release and of the five newest releases, in plain Markdown. The status and every
change of each release are in **CHANGELOG-big.md**, which is the one that is
written. **CodeQL** alert #598 in the Sandstorm host test is fixed, and the
release script pulls before releasing, so a moved main no longer stops it.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG-big.md#v1273-2026-10-30-wekan--release)

name: v12.72
body:
## In short

A card link can no longer launch an operating-system handler with
a code-execution history, such as **ms-msdt** (Follina) or **telnet**, even if
an administrator lists it, and an attempt to write one shows in **Admin Panel →
Problems**. The **Apache** guide follows the 2024 Confusion Attacks, and the
Sandstorm store build publishes to **both app markets**.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#v1272-2026-10-30-wekan--release)

name: v12.71
body:
## In short

The **Sandstorm** build installs Sandstorm from
**install.sandstorm.org**, as the Sandstorm workflows already did, and the
docs link sandstorm.org. The Hall of Fame guards read every vulnerability name
now that each one links to its own page.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#v1271-2026-10-30-wekan--release)

name: v12.70
body:
## In short

The **AppImages** and the **Launchpad** snaps build again: their
FerretDB and mongo-tools are readable by every user, and the snap source
carries what its downloads need. **Continuous backup** names a changed
encrypted file as changed with **OpenSSL 4**, and the release and test tooling
runs on macOS and reports a bad certificate as one.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#v1270-2026-10-29-wekan--release)

name: v12.69
body:
## In short **ImportPlacementBleed** is fixed: an import is placed only on its own board. **Invite via Email** adds the invited new user again, instead of the first user of the database. The **OpenBSD** bundle starts again, and **History** works on **FerretDB**: date custom field changes are recorded there, and the database migration says when documents did not arrive. ## Security
An import into a board is placed only beside that board's own list, swimlane or card. Thanks to Zachariah Mithani (AploSec) and xet7. The scoped importer, reached by `POST /api/import/zip` and the `importScoped` method, authorized the import on `boardId` alone. The `listId` and `swimlaneId` beside it were written onto the new cards as given, and a `cardId` was looked up with no board, so a writer of board A could create cards on A whose list and swimlane were board B's, and probe whether a card id existed on a board they cannot see. Before anything is written, the list, swimlane and card are now looked up together with the board's id; an id of another board is refused (400 over REST, `error-import-placement` from the method), with the same answer for a foreign card and a missing one. A refusal is shown in Admin Panel → Problems as ImportPlacementBleed, without blocking the account, since an import menu left open while its list moved can reach it. `tests/importPlacementBleed.test.cjs` pins the decision, the check before every write and a negative scan for a target id used without the board; `security-import-placement.e2e.js` runs the reporter's attack by both routes and fails on the previous code.
Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions. [More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#v1269-2026-10-29-wekan--release)

name: v12.68
body:
## In short

**Card Settings**, in Board Settings / Card, becomes two panes of
checklists - the minicard's and the card's - with a checkbox per section and
the board's custom fields as items, and the opened card and the minicard
follow its sections and order; every opened card shows every field its board
allows, empty or not. WeKan moves to **Meteor 3.6-rc.1**, keeping its own
security additions to Meteor's packages. **Data health** in Admin Panel /
Problems can now clean up custom fields whose boards were all deleted, and
empty fields no longer show **Scrum** sections on boards that have Scrum
turned off.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#v1268-2026-10-29-wekan--release)

name: v12.67
body:
## In short

a list's **Add card** form closes once the card is added, unless
**Member Settings** keeps it open for the next one. And the v12.66 release build
is whole again: the **emulated-CPU Linux bundles** and **win32**, **FreeBSD**,
**OpenBSD**, the **Mac app**, the **Sandstorm** .spk, the **Ondra** and **Gantt
GPL** snaps and the **Bun** bundles had failed to build or to start - most
because build scripts had moved their files into `.tools/` and some callers had
not.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#v1267-2026-10-28-wekan--release)

name: v12.66
body:
## In short

two CRITICAL security fixes: **UploadBleed** - attachment uploads
were not authorized at all - and **StampBleed**, and a **FrameBleed** follow-up.
**Card Settings** opens on Card, with **Show empty fields**, a **Show empty**
column, **Select all** / **Select none** and **drag and drop** lists. A card
opened from its link no longer vanishes behind a **reverse proxy**; minicards
show only filled custom fields, lost cards reappear, card numbers stay unique, a
[label] title prefix is opt-in, Problems gets a nightly **Data health** scan,
**database load** on many-pod installations drops, and the **API's JSON
uploads** and the site logo are stored again.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#v1266-2026-10-28-wekan--release)

name: v12.65
body:
## In short

an **opened card** shows only the fields it has, with **+ Add**
for the rest. **Drawing** works with a pen on the whole window - from Add Card
and Add attachment, saved as SVG, with an eraser, palm rejection and a lasso
that moves, resizes, groups and layers lines - and **SVG** is an image again,
sanitized whole at any size, streaming, on upload and on every serve.
**FerretDB** answers WeKan's queries in the database on every backend, and
**SQLite** stores documents as JSONB. **Right-to-left** checkboxes and list
resizing are fixed.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#v1265-2026-10-25-wekan--release)

name: v12.64
body:
## In short

a **database speed test** times the common WeKan queries on every
database WeKan runs on, with twice a production WeKan of data, and checks they
all answer the same; its findings made **FerretDB** several times faster and
stopped MariaDB losing edits. Every platform runs the prebuilt
**ferretdb-sqlite**
FerretDB, the **Sandstorm .spk** carries only what a grain runs, and every build
loads **collection2** before the models.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#v1264-2026-10-24-wekan--release)

name: v12.63
body:
## In short

copying a card, linking it to another board or making one from a
**card template** no longer fails when the card carries values of another
board's **custom fields**, and no longer records AdminFieldBleed against the
user who tried.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#v1263-2026-10-22-wekan--release)

name: v12.62
body:
## In short

an opened card is **decluttered** - add buttons on their title's
line, a compact attachment list with its upload rules in the upload popup, and
two new **Show on Card** rows for attachment previews and details - and
**Board Settings / Card** spreads into columns to fit the screen, with rows
dragged by handle, icon or label. List moves no longer raise false
**HistoryIntegrity** reports, refused edits no longer **disable accounts**, and
a
restarting database is no longer a **crash**.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#v1262-2026-10-22-wekan--release)

name: v12.61
body:
## In short

WeKan's npm dependencies move to their newest versions, among
them **Blockly 13.4**, whose new toolbox search is translated into every
language, and **imapflow**, **mailparser**, **pdfjs-dist** and
**isomorphic-git**, which now have tests that run them the way WeKan does. The
**core26 snap** gets the Caddy part the main snap already had, a language saved
as **ca@valencia** shows Valencian, and **Admin Panel / Problems** stops
re-reporting list indexes and calling a lost connection a schema bug.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#v1261-2026-10-22-wekan--release)

name: v12.60
body:
## In short

**sanitize-html 2.18.1** fixes a stack overflow that nested
`<iframe>` tags caused in WeKan's import and export sanitizer, and a failed
import or export no longer **disables the account** of whoever ran it unless it
was an attempt. The forked Meteor **dynamic-import** and **meteor shell** keys
come from the crypto RNG.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#v1260-2026-10-22-wekan--release)

name: v12.58
body:
## In short

an existing board can be **saved as a board template**, large
**Jira** exports import instead of failing, and **comments** stay with a card
moved to another board. A **GitHub CodeQL** alert in a test is fixed.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#v1258-2026-10-21-wekan--release)

name: v12.57
body:
## In short

attachments can be **deleted after a set time** and deleted ones
**purged**, every **backup** is recorded with failures and overdue runs shown,
and the newest features' settings are on **every platform** and in the **Admin
Panel**. Adding a board member by email works whatever the letter case, and the
**Security report** stops crying wolf.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#v1257-2026-10-20-wekan--release)
